evidence.blast_radius: LOW today — routed_to is documented as informational only and PO Step 0-SIG re-reads the inbox as SSOT. It is a latent trap for any future consumer that string-matches routed_to.

finding_1.root_cause: the queue plane has no shared implementation, so the (type,from) routing-table lookup is re-derived by hand every tick and the label spelling is whatever that tick executor typed

finding_2.what: gcc-preflight T6 worktree-lock expiry sweep is dead code as written

evidence.spec_glob: docs/agents/dev-team/flow/main.md gcc-preflight: for each f in .claude/worktrees/*/.git/*.lock
evidence.why_dead: in a LINKED worktree .git is a FILE (a gitdir: pointer), not a directory — verified: .claude/worktrees/agent-ae9ed2cd6f04b3686/.git is 128B ASCII text. The glob matched 0 files.
evidence.near_miss: a broader find over .claude/worktrees matched bun.lock, Bun package lockfile at the worktree root. Deleting it would have destroyed real content in the protected worktree holding 11 days of uncommitted work. The narrow documented glob is what prevented that — widening it naively is the WRONG fix.

finding_2.suggested_shape_not_prescribed: resolve the lock dir via git rev-parse --git-dir / the gitdir pointer rather than assuming .git is a directory, and keep the pattern anchored to git lock names so it can never match project lockfiles
